expectations.text: Extracted titles are phrased as claims/propositions, not topic labels
expectations.evidence: Three representative titles: (1) 'temporal averaging of frame-level features discards sub-unit sequential information in bioacoustic analysis' — propositional claim with verb. (2) 'caller identity is encoded more strongly than call type in the acoustic signal of animal vocalizations' — comparative claim. (3) 'k-NN classification with Levenshtein distance loses discriminative information that more sophisticated sequence models could preserve' — causal claim. All are full propositions, not topic labels.
